Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your message, which we have processed.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €32.00 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 19890 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months.
Please note:
We acknowledge your counter-offer.
We can accommodate the 56-day lead time and have adjusted our price to €32.00 per unit accordingly.
Please address any further questions in writing to this office.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your message, which we have processed.
This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.
Our terms: a price of €31.90 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 19890 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months.
Please note:
We note your revised offer; however, a nominal adjustment of three cents is insufficient for our specialized components.
We are prepared to adjust our price to €31.90 per unit for this allocated volume.
Our Lieferzeit is 56 days.
Which volume can you commit to?
These are our standard conditions for this product.
Please address any further questions in writing to this office.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
